name: Temporal Dissonance slows Chronostasis by a further 10% (#1968)
contract: Temporal Dissonance 520922 carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 (3) and EffectSpellClassMask word0 bit 0x40000; EffectBasePoints -11 resolves to -10 with DieSides 1, matching the tooltip "Chronostasis now slows your target's movement speed by an additional $s1%." Chronostasis 706969 has SpellFamilyFlags word0 262144 and effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED (33) with EffectBasePoints -61, i.e. a -60% slow, so the talent takes it to -70%. Native path only: SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue calls Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, which applies SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS and then SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 for effect index 0. The assertion is relative to the control's own computed value so a module base-value hook on the slow cannot mask the modifier.
